label: STRESS · new evidence
text: A reviewer checks a separate record of switching to a backup and restarting. It shows that the request ID, its result and the reservation are saved together: either all are saved or none is (an atomic save). They remain in storage after restart. Sending the same ID again after restart returns the saved result without creating a second reservation. This evidence covers one booking store. It does not cover actions in an outside payment service. Compare this evidence with your simulator results and explain whether keeping your retry rule within these limits is justified.
